description: Update a translation draft. Transition a draft's lifecycle state (`open` / `merged` / `abandoned`).

draftId.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

status.description: New lifecycle state for the draft.

name: i18n_drafts_update
